primitives.name: User Compliance State
primitives.verbatim_quote: ### `UserCompliance` One row per user, the durable compliance facts.
primitives.assumptions: Each user has a single immutable compliance record; attestation and exclusion are mutually exclusive temporal events.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When `now >= selfExclusionExpiresAt`, exclusion state resets to inactive.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI's probabilistic risk model where attestation and exclusion act as binary observables in a Markovian compliance chain.
layer2.telemetry: Timestamps of attestation and exclusion events.

primitives.name: Age Attestation Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: | | `ageAttestedAt` | `DateTime?` | set when the user affirms they meet the minimum age.
primitives.assumptions: User affirmatively declares age compliance; no verification occurs.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If `ageAttestedAt` is null, access is denied until affirmation.

layer2.mapping: Derived from `UserCompliance` state; used in GSE access control logic to gate entry.
layer2.telemetry: Boolean flag indicating presence of attestation timestamp.

primitives.name: Self Exclusion Event
primitives.verbatim_quote: | Field | Type | Notes | |---|---|---| | `userId` | `String` `@id` | FK to the auth user id.
primitives.assumptions: Exclusion is initiated by user and enforced by system until expiration.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Access blocked if current time is less than `selfExclusionExpiresAt`.

layer2.mapping: Triggers GSE state transition to restricted access mode; logs reversal attempts.
layer2.telemetry: Timestamps of exclusion start and end times.
